name: Halcyon
description: The Thran capital, destroyed when the Null Sphere was sabotaged.

description_citations.text: "Yawgmoth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rebbec seals the portal to Phyrexia, locking Yawgmoth out for millennia as Halcyon falls.
timeline.quote: Rebbec managed to seal the portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia, locking Yawgmoth out for millennia.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Thran Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth takes control of the Null Sphere in the Battle of the Null Sphere and turns artifact creatures on their masters.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth took control of it in what is known as the Battle of the Null Sphere

citation.text: "Null Moon", section "Null Sphere". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sphere's operators rebel and jettison it into orbit; the stonechargers wipe out Yawgmoth's army and mutate survivors into warped Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: the irradiative cloud released by the stonechargers mutated the survivors into the iconically warped Phyrexians

citation.text: "Null Moon", section "Null Sphere". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gix stabbed Glacian with a powerstone, making him ill.
timeline.quote: When her husband was stabbed with a powerstone by Gix

citation.text: "Rebbec", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rebbec used her influence to have Yawgmoth return from exile to cure Glacian.
timeline.quote: Rebbec used her influence to have the eugenicist Yawgmoth return from exile.

citation.text: "Rebbec", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth diluted the serum given to the Untouchables to provoke another insurrection and took over the Halcyte Guard.
timeline.quote: He deliberately diluted the serum he was giving to the Untouchables to cause another insurrection

citation.text: "Rebbec", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth and Rebbec began falling in love without acting on it.
timeline.quote: Rebbec and Yawgmoth started falling in love, although neither of them acted upon it.

citation.text: "Rebbec", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth overthrew the council and imprisoned its elders and the delegates after the vote on his stay split evenly.
timeline.quote: He immediately overthrew the council and imprisoned its elders, as well as the delegates.

citation.text: "Rebbec", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rebbec returned to find Glacian dead and Halcyon devastated by Yawgmoth's cloud of energy.
timeline.quote: She found Glacian dead and discovered the powerstones Yawgmoth had implanted in him.

citation.text: "Rebbec", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rebbec placed the powerstone on the pedestal to seal Yawgmoth and the Phyrexians away from Dominaria, then ascended into the white cloud.
timeline.quote: This would seal Yawgmoth and the Phyrexians away from their home plane of Dominaria.

citation.text: "Rebbec", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glacian is stabbed with a powerstone by Gix during a riot in the Mana Rig and falls ill; Rebbec recalls the exiled Yawgmoth to heal him.
timeline.quote: His wife Rebbec uses her influence as the city's main architect to recall the exiled eugenicist Yawgmoth

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 1: The City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth discovers that powerstones cause phthisis; Gix learns it and escapes, wanting vengeance for his people.
timeline.quote: Gix escapes upon hearing this, wanting vengeance for his people.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 1: The City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gix leads a massive rebellion, which Yawgmoth quells by offering free serum; he is made a member of the council.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth manages to quell the revolt by offering free serum to the Untouchables.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 1: The City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The planeswalker Dyfed visits Glacian and Yawgmoth talks her into finding a plane for his paradise.
timeline.quote: Dyfed agrees to find a plane where Yawgmoth can build his own paradise.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 2: The Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth uses an artifact based on Glacian's designs and the Halcyte Guard to crush Gix's second riot and bully him into obedience.
timeline.quote: bully Gix into complete obedience.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 2: The Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Delegates of the allied nations denounce Yawgmoth's atrocities; he survives a tied council vote, then overthrows the council and imprisons the elders and delegates.
timeline.quote: After this, Yawgmoth overthrows the council and imprisons its elders, as well as the delegates.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 3: The World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dyfed sends the captured elders to Mercadia at Rebbec's summons, at Glacian's urging.
timeline.quote: The planeswalker brings them to Mercadia , along with about two hundred of their goblin servants.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 3: The World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth's war caravel survives the Alliance's counterattack; a Phyrexian warrior carries him back and he recognizes Xod.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth realizes it is Xod, the healer who gave him the inspiration for the serum so many years before.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 4: The Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Thran Temple falls to the death cloud, and Yawgmoth persuades Halcyon's remaining inhabitants to flee to Phyrexia, where they are killed and made into newts.
timeline.quote: they try to flee again but are killed and used to create new Phyrexian newts .

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 4: The Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rebbec walks out of the Caves into the white cloud covering Halcyon.
timeline.quote: Rebbec ascends the stairs out of the Caves of the Damned and walks into the white cloud covering Halcyon.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 4: The Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Thran Civil War between artificers and eugenicists ends with the exile of eugenicists including Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: led to the exile of prominent eugenicists, Yawgmoth among them, after 100 years of civil war.

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Early History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glacian is wounded in an Untouchable riot and contracts an incurable disease.
timeline.quote: was wounded in an Untouchable riot and contracted an unknown disease

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Unrest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Rebbec's behest the Elder Council recalls Yawgmoth, who diagnoses phthisis.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth ultimately diagnosed the illness as phthisis

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Unrest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth expands his influence amid the unrest.
timeline.quote: Throughout the unrest, Yawgmoth expanded his influence through a combination of political maneuvering and genuine Thran artifice.

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Unrest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The planeswalker Dyfed arrives in Halcyon, setting off events leading to the empire's downfall.
timeline.quote: The arrival of the planeswalker Dyfed 4 years before the Thran-Phyrexian War set off a series of events

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rebbec and Yawgmoth narrowly defeat the Alliance's ultimatum, then Yawgmoth overthrows the council and declares martial law.
timeline.quote: Immediately thereafter, Yawgmoth overthrew the council entirely and declared martial law.

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth has Dyfed exile the council to Mercadia.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth called upon Dyfed to exile the council to Mercadia

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth opens a portal between Phyrexia and the caves below Halcyon and offers it as refuge.
timeline.quote: he opened an interplanar portal between Phyrexia and the caves below Halcyon

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth slaughters the Halcite population for parts to build Phyrexian horrors.
timeline.quote: he slaughtered the Halcite population for raw parts from which to construct Phyrexian horrors.

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Almost all the Thran are killed or flee to Phyrexia; Rebbec closes the portal.
timeline.quote: the portal to that plane was then closed in a final defiant act by Rebbec.

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glacian falls ill from phthisis and Yawgmoth is recalled, becoming the most powerful person in the empire.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth managed to become the most powerful person in the empire

citation.text: "Thran-Phyrexian War", section "Before the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Artificers sabotage the Null Sphere and the stonechargers destroy Halcyon along with the armies.
timeline.quote: all of Halcyon was as well

citation.text: "Thran-Phyrexian War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth is recalled to Halcyon when Rebbec seeks a cure for Glacian's disease.
timeline.quote: Glacian's wife Rebbec used her influence as chief architect to bring Yawgmoth back

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth discovers phthisis is caused by powerstone radiation and Gix begins rallying the Untouchables to revolt.
timeline.quote: Gix , started rallying his fellow Untouchables to rebel and take vengeance upon the Thran.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Rise to Power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth quells Gix's rebellion with free serum and is made a member of the Halcyon council.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth was made a member of the council of Halcyon

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Rise to Power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: It is discovered that Yawgmoth is diluting the serum, and he uses the resulting unrest to gain control of the Halcyte Guard.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth used this development to attain more funding and complete control over the Halcyte Guard.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Rise to Power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth talks the planeswalker Dyfed into finding a plane for his paradise.
timeline.quote: Dyfed agreed to find a plane where Yawgmoth could build his paradise.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Rise to Power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth uses an artifact to control all powerstone technology and forces Gix into obedience.
timeline.quote: he managed to stop the invasion and force Gix into complete obedience.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Rise to Power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Delegates declare war on Yawgmoth's supporters; Yawgmoth and Rebbec cast the tie-breaking votes, and Yawgmoth overthrows the council.
timeline.quote: He immediately overthrew the council and imprisoned its elders, as well as the delegates.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Thran-Phyrexian War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The artificers sabotage the Null Sphere, destroying Halcyon.
timeline.quote: Halcyon was destroyed, all its inhabitants fleeing to Phyrexia or being eaten away.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Thran-Phyrexian War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
